Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** it is local-only: CI's runner is ephemeral and never calls the stop script.
- **Lane:** `domain:devx`. The landing is `e2e/live/ci/**`, `domain:devx` (seat #5748).

Claim: PM loop round 3 · `domain:devx` @ objectui seat 1 · 2026-10-16T15:53Z · triage first grade `6218603998` (p3, `domain:devx`, `pm:queue`)

Domain: `domain:devx`
Seat: `domain:devx#1`
File surface: `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` (how the backend is backgrounded and which PID goes to `backend.pid`), and `e2e/live/ci/stop-backend.sh` only if the fix needs it there. Also `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`, only where it describes stopping the backend, and one empty-frontmatter `.changeset/*.md` if the changeset gate asks. ⛔ No `.github/workflows/**`. ⛔ Nothing kills by port or by process name (AGENTS.md service discipline). Stop on breach and explain it in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `start-backend.sh:143-145 records $! of a backgrounded cd && nohup list, which is the forked subshell, not the server | none: stop-backend.sh trusts the recorded PID by design | every local run of the live-backend scripts (CI unaffected)`
Thread-read: 6218603998
Serial constraints cleared:
- Concurrency 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20163 `6216376921`). In flight: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23950 (claim `6218158623`). objectstack-ai/objectstack#23975 waits on an authorised approval with no dev running, so it holds no slot. This is the second slot.
- None of the 10 open objectui PRs touches `e2e/live/**`. Their file lists were read at this act.

## Landed: `stop-backend.sh` stops the live backend it started · `domain:devx` @ objectui seat 1 · `session_016PVjjuVPte5XEJvaQx1E4t` · 2026-10-16T16:48Z

| reading | value |
|:--|:--|
| merge | #12737 → `c220689221` on objectui `origin/main`, merged 2026-10-16T16:48:19Z from the merge queue |
| blob identity | `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` on `origin/main` is `8f54de6cf7`, equal to the PR head `3a0843dcf` |

- **State change:** #12737's `Fixes` closed this card as `completed`. `pm:dispatched` is removed in this act.
- **What now holds:** `start-backend.sh` records the `objectstack dev` process itself in `backend.pid`. `stop-backend.sh` therefore takes down the whole server tree, and a second `start` reports "already running" instead of booting a second server on the next port. CI's path is unchanged.
- **Note:** the dispatch's first run was lost to a container restart. Its commit survived and a resumed run verified it, so the PR carries that one commit.
